name: Ancestral Heritage (Fetchling)
body:
The human ancestry that fetchlings come from appears more prominently in you.

Prerequisite: Fetchling

Benefit: You count as both fetchling and human and for any effects related to race, such as taking traits, feats, how spells and magic items affect you, and so on.

Special: You may not take the Racial Heritage feat, even though it is normally available to humans.
